_meta.one_fact_one_home: Field names (genre, venue_track, companion_of, claim_card.*) are defined only in schema/*.schema.json; this file references them.
source: design/FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §6.4 (mandatory gates threaded through every genre)
cpg_research_journal/research/rigour-without-infrastructure/design/S11_research-structure-dags.md §10 (Thai TCI distinction, Dr, unverified against a live TCI journal)
_meta.note_thai_tci: S11 §10 is explicitly Dr — a designer's synthesis of general Thai academic convention, NOT verified against a live TCI journal's own author guidelines. Before gating an actual submission, fetch and cite the specific target journal's own guidelines.

universal_gates: review_report.independence_class >= I3 on file, OR the bounded I2+I4 exception (D-SAME-VENDOR emitted, independent_check.expires_at <= 90 days)
every citation reachable from the paper at citation_card.status == VERIFIED
origin_blackbox_ref populated and the Blackbox Note appendix present
related-work section routes through design/S13_neighbour-table.md's format (same/different/cited per neighbour), fed by search_log + citation cards
produced_by / responsible visible per claim, not just at document level

บทความวิจัย (เชิงปริมาณ)
genres.claim_ceiling: [result] only if CI excludes null, else [directional]

genres.name_th: บทความวิจัย (เชิงคุณภาพ/ปฏิบัติ)

genres.claim_ceiling: Ceiling bounded by weakest included source's tier
sections: Search protocol (search_log.review_mode label, hard block on mislabeling: FC-S8-1)

genres.name_th: บทความโต้ตอบ/แสดงจุดยืน
genres.claim_ceiling: Dr; ceiling capped by the target claim's own independence class (Bounded-Judge Law)

international.requirements: no additional section/format requirements beyond the genre's own column

thai_tci.applies_to: any of the 9 genre rows when venue_track == thai_tci
thai_tci.tier: Dr — synthesis of general Thai academic convention, not verified against a live TCI journal (see _meta.note_thai_tci)

conceptual_track_academic_article_baak_k.thai_label: บทความวิชาการ
typical_sections_th_en: เนื้อหา/การทบทวนวรรณกรรมและการวิเคราะห์ (Body — literature synthesis and analysis)
เอกสารอ้างอิง (References)
conceptual_track_academic_article_baak_k.ethics_committee_disclosure: Typically not required — no human/animal subjects, no original data collection
conceptual_track_academic_article_baak_k.mismatch_failure_mode: Submitting a literature synthesis labeled บทความวิจัย gets rejected for genre mismatch, not quality — reviewers expect a Methods/Results section that does not exist

empirical_track_research_article_baak_ka.thai_label: บทความวิจัย
typical_sections_th_en: ทบทวนวรรณกรรม (Literature review)
วิธีดำเนินการวิจัย (Methods)
ผลการวิจัย (Results)
สรุปและข้อเสนอแนะ (Conclusion/Recommendations)
เอกสารอ้างอิง (References)
empirical_track_research_article_baak_ka.ethics_committee_disclosure: Typically required when human participants are involved — matches claim_type == HUMAN_PARTICIPANT gate; journal usually asks for an ethics-committee approval number
empirical_track_research_article_baak_ka.mismatch_failure_mode: Submitting original empirical work labeled บทความวิชาการ risks the paper being read as making no original-findings claim, so the empirical contribution and required ethics disclosure may be overlooked

tci_reviewer_expectation_checklist: section labels in Thai matching the applicable track above
thai_tci.ceiling_and_disclaimer_rule: venue_track adds section/format/disclosure requirements only — it never raises or lowers the genre's own claim ceiling or mandatory-disclaimer set
thai_tci.open_founder_question: Which specific TCI-tier journal(s), if any, RWI or its companion papers actually target — author guidelines differ journal-to-journal (S11 §10, not resolved unilaterally)

none.requirements: legal for K0 work never intended for any venue; no venue-format obligations apply

companion_of.applies_to: any genre when companion_of is non-null
companion_of.rule: the companion artifact inherits its target's structure and never exceeds the target's own tier merely by rewriting
companion_of.translation_rule: Thai content is rewritten, not translated verbatim, per claim_card.statement.translation.translation_status

genre_routing_procedure_ref: design/FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §6.3b — 9-step ordered decision procedure, each question computable from a named claim_card field, terminating in one of the 9 genre ids above or MIXED_GENRE
